english.title: Cause death by careless / inconsiderate driving

english.legislation: Contrary to section 2B of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence was inserted into the Road Traffic Act1988 by section 20 of the Road Safety Act 2006.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Five years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three to eleven penalty points.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see Part 1 ofSchedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
